{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float: remove commas and cast to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders: revenue = 999999.99
df = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for the population: new customers, reached by paid_search, completed status
df_new_paid_search = df[
    (df['customer_segment'] == 'new') &
    (df['channel'] == 'paid_search') &
    (df['status'] == 'completed')
]

# Check: how many rows in this population?
len_new_paid_search = len(df_new_paid_search)

# Compute conversion rate: fraction of converted orders in this group
converted_count = df_new_paid_search['converted'].sum()
conversion_rate = converted_count / len_new_paid_search

# Print results
conversion_rate, len_new_paid_search"}
